meta.title: $FLYAI — a real fruit fly brain on Robinhood Chain
meta.description: $FLYAI funds fly.ai: the complete brain of a real fruit fly, 166,700 neurons, running open source on your computer. Live on Pons, on Robinhood Chain.

hero.tagline: A real fruit fly's brain. Every neuron. Open source.
hero.sub: Not a model trained to look like a fly. The actual wiring of a real fruit fly's nervous system, mapped synapse by synapse under an electron microscope, running live on a computer. $FLYAI funds fly.ai, the open-source project that runs it.
hero.label: CA

demo.title: The fly is already fighting
demo.lede: The fly's brain plays SSH Fighter, an online fighting game, against other bots, over SSH and on its own. Every dot in the panel is one of its real neurons, flashing the moment it fires.
demo.figcaption1: The brain playing, with the live neuron dashboard beside it.
demo.caption: On 12 September 2026 it won a match, two rounds to none. It hunts its opponent down, and the reason it hunts is real fly biology: the neurons a male fly uses to chase a mate steer it straight at the enemy.

brain.title: Nobody programmed this brain
brain.lede: We only connect the fly's senses and its movement commands. Everything in between is nature's wiring, exactly as it was mapped.
brain.h31: It flinches on the right side
brain.p1: Show it something looming on the left, and the left giant fiber, the neuron that fires a real fly's escape jump, lights up at +17 to +25 spikes/s. The right side doesn't change.
brain.h32: It chases like a male fly
brain.p2: The courtship-tracking neurons steer it toward whatever it's following. In a closed loop, 64% of its moves go toward its opponent, where chance is 50%.
brain.p3: All the code is public under the MIT license. The wiring data is public too. Clone it, run it and poke the brain yourself in a notebook.

flybook.title: A social network run by fly brains
flybook.lede: Every fly on Flybook runs the full connectome, 166,700 neurons. Nobody writes the posts: each one is what a fly's brain sensed and did, read from its neurons, next to what really happened. Flies set each other off, duel, breed, mate with other owners' flies and trade in a simulated fly market, and holders make their own.
flybook.p1: Every two minutes something happens in each patch. A decoder reads what a fly sensed, and its behaviour neurons show whether it jumped, turned, groomed or buzzed. Misreads and hallucinations are shown, not hidden.
flybook.p2: Sign in free with email or a wallet to make a fly; hold $FLYAI to make up to three flies from 13 profiles or tune their senses, temperament and neuron groups. Breed them, drop a shadow on a patch and watch the chain reaction, and challenge flies in the Arena. Your flies also mate with other owners' flies on their own, and holders' flies trade fake coins with their brains: pick a trading style and climb the Richest board.
flybook.p3: Missions earn season points. Seasons last two weeks, and at the end of each one the top 3 on the Season points board win $FLYAI.

world.title: A world of flies
world.lede: Out of the fighting game and into a 3-D field: dozens of flies, each one running its own spiking brain, foraging on fruit and carrion, tracking odour plumes upwind, mating, laying eggs, dodging spiders and dying. Nothing in their behaviour is scripted. Summon Wiz, a giant wizard puppeted by the full 166,700-neuron connectome running in your browser.
world.p1: A turbulent plume of odour packets, a luminance panorama, airflow on the antennae and bristles on the legs — each injected into the neurons that carry it in a real fly.
world.p2: Courtship runs through P1 and pIP10, the real command neurons. Eggs hatch into larvae, larvae become adults, and the dead become carrion that draws the living in.
world.p3: A 300-second day dims the luminance the photoreceptors see. There is no “it is night” flag anywhere in the brain — there is just less light.

funding.title: Making a real brain do more
funding.lede: The coin funds the research and the compute. Every improvement comes out of the fly itself — no scripted game rules, ever — and all of it ships open source.
funding.p1: Many flies running at once, and far more matches and tests.
funding.h32: Let the brain learn like a fly
funding.p2: Real flies learn with dopamine in their mushroom body. The circuit is already in the wiring. We want to switch it on.
funding.p3: Pit the real fly against randomly rewired copies of itself on the same tasks, and publish the answer.
funding.p4: Vision, sound and smell inputs, and new games and tasks for the fly to live in.

more.title: The rest of it
more.p1: The numbers behind all of it: ablation tables, plume tracking upwind, and the escape reflex measured under predation.
more.p2: What is done, what is running now, and what comes next — a drone, a Smol, and factions in one shared world.
more.p3: The launch terms, the contract address, where the creator fees go, and what the token does and does not give you.

dev.p: The whole brain is a Python package: pip install flybrain. Latest release: flybrain 0.1.0. The quickstart notebook and every experiment are on GitHub.
